author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0035807 induction of blood coagulation in another organism & GO:0035899 suppression of blood coagulation in another organism
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30375

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1E4MEbUp1iUOrvLrHwxBI0zmRQaRYFGCkWCE1d4RmmNg/edit?gid=0#gid=0


Impacted groups: 
12 UniProt 
1 SignatureScience 
1 AgBase 


Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
NA 



Thanks.
